stages.name: governed-baseline
stages.purpose: Short ladder at the governed 2.0-CPU compose quota, same tooling and same endpoint mix as the raised-quota stage, so every raised-quota figure has a production-shaped comparator (t57 D2).

stages.name: raised-quota
stages.purpose: The same ladder with the compose quota raised from 2.0 to 5.0 CPUs per app node. Numbers from this stage are NOT production-shaped numbers and must never be presented as such.

stages.name: client-ceiling
stages.purpose: Identifier-free /health-only ladder. Establishes what the generator itself can offer before the application is meaningfully involved, so a later shortfall can be attributed to the right side of the wire.
